name: russian-speech
description: Literate Russian technical prose for the agent: a normative style skill plus an always-on SessionStart directive. Grammatical engineer-to-engineer Russian, meaning-first translation of engineering terms, no literal calques (lane, identity, reconcile, gate, trigger), exact resource names preserved. Ships a full glossary of false friends and preferred forms for CI/CD, GitOps, Kubernetes, GCP, IAM, Git, and testing.
